title: Manage Payment Portfolios
content_data:
This article walks you through how to manage Payment Portfolios using Payment Portfolios API. # Introduction Payment Portfolio is a one stop workspace that allows you to view and and manage your options for making payments, including credit lines, cash balance, ad credit, and payment methods, in a unified manner across TikTok for Business platforms. To learn more about Payment Portfolio, see [About Payment Portfolio](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/about-payment-portfolio). # Prerequisites - You've gained access to TikTok API for Business. See [Get Started - Step by step workflow](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1735713609895937) for details. - To manage Payment Portfolios, you need relevant permissions. See [API Reference](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1735713875563521) to find out permissions required for endpoints (including the endpoints listed in the "Steps" section) and see [Update app permissions](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738855280338946) to find out how to configure permissions. # Use cases overview The table below outlines the use cases and relevant endpoints to effectively manage Payment Portfolios:
Use Case Endpoint to Use
Retrieve Payment Portfolios /payment_portfolio/get/
Create a Payment Portfolio /payment_portfolio/create/
Link existing ad accounts to a Payment Portfolio /payment_portfolio/advertiser/update/
Allocate the credit Line to Payment Portfolios /payment_portfolio/credit_line/update/
Get ad accounts linked to a Payment Portfolio /payment_portfolio/advertiser/get/
Get authorized users for a Payment Portfolio /payment_portfolio/user/get/
